newsitem.title: USA: Magellan Technology to buy BioSource.
newsitem.headline: Magellan Technology to buy BioSource.

text.p: Magellan Technology Inc said Friday it had signed a letter of intent to acquire BioSource Inc of Orem, Utah.
BioSource is an international leader in Electro Dermal Screening, a computer-based technology used to assist healthcare practitioners screen a range of health disorders.

Magellan said it expects BioSource to increase the revenues of Magellan's subsidiary, ProHealth Inc, which has a joint venture with UICI to handle electronic claims submissions for the healthcare industry.
